content.title: Bridesmaid Dresses & Gowns From $79
content.text: About Bridesmaid DressesA happy bride needs her best girls on one of the most important occasions of her life. AW Bridal ensures both the bride and her bridesmaids look stunning and radiant as they walk down the aisle. This is why we offer a good selection of bridesmaid dresses to make them look their most fabulous at their best friend's wedding.With the right gowns taken care of, you can rest assured that you will have photos and mementos you will all gladly look back on for many years to come. Our designer AW Bridal bridesmaid dresses are a refined blend of luxury and modesty. They come in many comfy and stylish fabrics and different colors, including sage green, dusty blue, burgundy, champagne, dark emerald, and more.At AW Bridal, you will find classic and modest styles in a variety of cuts and sizes. These dresses are available in up to 60 different shades, allowing you to choose a color that matches your theme and preferences. We also offer a variety of formal wedding dresses, flower girl accessories, favors, and decorations for less—all in one place. What’s more, we have elegant flower baskets, bouquets, fresh flowers, and colorful wedding umbrellas to add beauty and aesthetics to your special day.Yes, we absolutely offer custom sizing, and the best part is that it is 100% free! We believe every bridesmaid deserves a flawless fit without the burden of hidden fees. Here is what you need to know about our custom fit service: No Extra Cost: You get a dress tailored specifically to your body at the exact same price as a standard-size dress. How It Works: When adding a dress to your cart, simply select the "Custom Size" option and input your exact measurements (Bust, Waist, Hips, and Hollow-to-Hem). Save Time & Money: Ordering a custom-made gown significantly reduces—and often completely eliminates—the need for expensive local alterations before the wedding.For the most accurate fit, use a soft measuring tape and wear the exact bra and shoes you plan to wear on the wedding day. Have a friend help you measure around the fullest part of your bust and hips, the narrowest part of your natural waist (keeping the tape comfortably loose), and your "hollow-to-hem" length—measuring straight down from the center of your collarbone to your desired hemline with your shoes on.Absolutely! Our collection features an inclusive size range from US 0 to US 30 to celebrate every body type. Many of our flowy dresses are inherently maternity-friendly, and pregnant bridesmaids can easily use our Free Custom Sizing service to request the perfect amount of extra room for a growing bump.While the bridal industry traditionally recommends ordering 3-4 months in advance, AW Bridal's efficient made-to-order process is much faster! Standard tailoring and shipping usually take just a few weeks, and we also offer expedited options at checkout for last-minute orders.We highly recommend placing your order at least 2 to 3 months before the wedding. This ensures plenty of time for our made-to-order production, shipping, and any minor local alterations you might need before the big day! (Pro tip: To guarantee the exact same color match across the bridal party, it is best for all bridesmaids to order their dresses within 24 hours of each other.)To pull off the perfect mix-and-match bridal party, keep at least one element consistent! The most popular approach is choosing the same color and fabric (like Dusty Blue chiffon) and letting your bridesmaids pick a dress style that flatters their unique body shape. Alternatively, you can mix complementary colors within the same fabric.Yes, but only if they are cut from the exact same roll of fabric! Because fabrics are dyed in batches, slight color variations—known as a "dye lot" difference—can occur between orders placed at different times. To guarantee a 100% perfect color match across your bridal party, we highly recommend placing a group order or having all bridesmaids place their orders within 24 hours of each other.Bridesmaid dress color trends are shifting toward universally flattering botanical greens (like sage, emerald, and olive) and romantic blues (such as dusty and baby blue) that look stunning in natural light.Yes, absolutely! The days of "wear-it-once" gowns are over. Our modern bridesmaid dresses are specifically designed with "rewearability" in mind. By choosing a gown with a simple, elegant silhouette (like a sleek slip dress or a classic A-line), it is incredibly easy to repurpose. Just swap your shoes, add a statement necklace or a chic jacket, and your dress instantly transforms into a gorgeous outfit for another wedding, holiday party, or formal event!Yes! With our Home Try-On Program, you can select 1-3 sample dresses for just $10 each and try them on comfortably at home for 5 days. Both shipping and returns are completely free! Once you've found your perfect fit, simply mail the samples back and order your brand-new, custom-fit dress online.For more details on how it works, please visit our Home Try-On Page.We highly recommend seeing our colors in person before making a decision! Simply visit the Swatches section on our website to choose your favorite shades and materials. Plus, you can currently use the promo code FREESWA at checkout to get 5 FREE swatches delivered right to your door!We offer a premium selection of fabrics for every wedding style, including breathable chiffon for outdoor spring events, elegant satin for formal indoor weddings, and luxurious velvet for the colder fall and winter months. We also feature romantic tulle and lace, as well as comfortable stretch fabrics for easy dancing, and we highly recommend ordering our fabric swatches to see and feel your favorite options in person before making a final decision!
